fields.label: Lantern
fields.description: A living colony crystal, a bunch of rounded blue lobes grown from one root and lit softly from within. Its light is warmer and steadier than raw lanternstone, and the things of the Deep do not come to it. Harvested, it breaks down into ordinary lanternstone, and that light they do notice. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: dead chassis
fields.description: A high-technology work droid, long dead: its power cell slagged, its plating scored by years in the dark. A thin vein of blue crystal has grown into its open power port. Near one of the aware crystals, such a chassis stands up and labours at the rock, patient as water, at a task nobody assigned. It does not answer hails and it does not defend itself. When light comes near, it stops and turns toward it. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: shard-mind
fields.description: One massive dark crystal grown up through the cave floor, its faces unnervingly still and evenly lit. Fine veins of light run out of it along the ground. It is aware. Dead machines near it stand up and work, and living ones sometimes stop and stand facing it, as if listening. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: Orun-Ghal
fields.description: A mining exoframe three times a man's height, dead for longer than anyone has kept count, and walking. Its cracked canopy still holds the skeleton of the miner who wore it; blue crystal has grown through every joint and out of its back like antlers of glass. The crystals move it now. Its drill-arms hang lowered and unused: whatever the minds in the rock want, it is not to dig. It walks its rounds through the Deep, it lingers by the light, and it lets itself be looked at. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: drifter
fields.description: A head-sized bladder of pale blue skin drifting a hand's breadth above the floor, a heavy yellow slosh settled in its lower third and a fringe of threads hanging beneath. It floats on methane and grazes the light off glow-fungi, glowing faintly itself. Killed with a blade it collapses into a harmless sac of fuel; killed by fire, a spark or a hot bullet, it goes up. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: candler
fields.description: A slow slab of pale blue, legless, moving on a single broad foot, with a swollen dorsal sac of the brightest yellow in the Deep running down its spine. It stores its energy as wax. It can be milked for that cold wax, which burns like chemfuel and needs no refinery - and which will not stay inert anywhere warm. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: galuush
fields.description: A sun hung under the mountain: one vast bladder of skin so thin the yellow inside is the whole picture, a slow-turning core of hydrocarbon fluid brightest at its heart, crowned underneath with soft filaments that stir in no wind. It hangs in its chamber and almost never moves, lighting the whole hall blue-gold, and everything in the Deep that is drawn to light gathers beneath it. Killed cold it is a fortune in fuel. Killed hot, the chamber goes up with it. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: chiller
fields.description: A squat barrel on four thick columns, crusted white with rime that flakes off as it walks, with a row of clear blue vanes along its back that fan when it works. It is colder than the cave: it pumps heat out of itself into the rock, and the air around it falls with it. A chiller penned in a store room is a freezer that needs no power; a chiller in the barracks is a hypothermia incident. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: shoal
fields.description: Many bodies sharing one blood: small pale lozenges strung on a single glowing yellow thread, a shoal of eight to fifteen moving as one loose net. Wound one and the fluid moves between them - the hurt is spread across the net, and the net heals itself fast while it stays together. To kill one you must wound the shoal. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: shared circulation
fields.description: Its fluid runs through the whole shoal: wounds close faster while others of its shoal are near. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: the Creep
fields.description: A crust of tiny interlocking blue-grey crystal facets spread across the floor like frost on a window, thicker toward its centre, its leading edge a fringe of needle crystal. It is alive and it is hunting, slowly: it dissolves behind and re-precipitates ahead, and it grows toward anything that lies still near it. Whatever sleeps on it is grown over. Break it or mine it away. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: grown over by the Creep
fields.description: Crystal has precipitated over this body while it lay still: a crust over the skin, then into the mouth and nose. It falls away slowly once the body is off the Creep. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: cleaver
fields.description: Five or six sharp angular shards of blue crystal held loosely together by stress-light along their fracture planes. A Cleaver has no head and no legs: it moves by fracturing, flinging a shard forward and re-forming around it, fast and violent, shedding fragments as it goes. Strike it hard and it splits, and the shard walks away as another Cleaver. Cleaving is birth. They are the caverns' true danger. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: cleaver shards
fields.description: Sharp blue crystal fragments shed by a Cleaver as it fractures its way across the floor. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: slick
fields.description: A long low string of glossy pale-blue bead-segments, each with a yellow drop inside, joined by clear necks, a ring of short feelers on the front bead. It has no legs; it pumps itself along in sequence and is always wet. It sweats pentane: every cell it crosses is left with a slick of fuel that does not evaporate in the cold, and that slick burns like a fuse. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: blinker
fields.description: A soft upright teardrop of pale translucent blue, about a metre tall, walking on two thin trailing arms like crutches. Where a face would be is a single large lens-window with the yellow interior showing through it, and a third shorter arm held over it like a hand over a torch. Hurt or cornered it flings the arm wide and flashes: everything that can see it is dazzled, and for a breath the whole chamber is lit. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: knocker
fields.description: A blind tripod: three long pale-blue stilt legs bending backward under a fist-sized body, and a long neck ending in a heavy translucent hammer-head of horn with the yellow fluid pooled inside it like a plumb-bob. It sees by tapping the rock, and it hears rock before it fails: at a roof about to fall it drums a fast alarm and runs. A tame one names the danger and gives you longer to prop it. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: blinker flash
fields.description: The light of a blinker's flash, gone in a breath. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: dazzled
fields.description: Looked straight into a blinker's flash: half-blind for a few seconds. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: hush
fields.description: The one thing in the Deep that does not glow: a wide flat sheet two cells across and less than a hand thick, matte black, with the faintest blue edge-light where a lamp catches its rim. At rest it lies over the fungal floor like a spill of shadow, and on unlit ground nothing can see it at all. Step within two cells and it peels up from the front edge and folds over you; the underside is a field of small pale-blue hooks. Light it and it is a plain black slab you can shoot from across the room. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: sipper
fields.description: A swarm vermin the size of a thumbnail: a clear bead of liquid in a pale-blue skin so thin the yellow droplet inside shows as a point of colour, on three hair-fine legs. Alone it is invisible; a swarm is a scatter of sparks. Sippers hop toward the brightest light near them and sit on it, drinking photons into pentane, and every one of them on a lamp makes it a little dimmer. They do not fight. They just come back. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: tapper
fields.description: A flat plate on many feet: a rounded pale-blue disc one cell wide, the yellow fluid inside branching through it in lightning-tree veins that brighten and dim in a slow pulse. It eats electricity. A wild tapper walks to your batteries, sits on them and drains them; a bank of them empties a battery bank in a night. A tame one never drains: it stores charge while the aurora storms over the Deep and pours it into any battery it sits beside. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: pooler
fields.description: A creature that is a puddle: a rounded meniscus of pale, cold-blue liquid with a slowly turning yellow core the size of a coin. It pours itself around obstacles and is drawn to warmth the way everything else here is drawn to light. It drapes itself over the warmest thing it can find: a fire under it goes out flat with no smoke, a heater stops, and a warm body under it chills fast until it is pushed off. Fire cannot touch it. A tame pooler hunts only fires. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

fields.label: unseen in the dark
fields.description: On unlit ground this creature is a hole in the floor: nothing that looks for it can find it. Light, a wound or its own strike shows it. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes
